_source: README Expected outcomes — E2E-30, NARROWED. Every stated outcome is invisible from GitHub: the filter drops findings BEFORE render, so a correctly-dropped finding and a never-emitted one look identical in the comment, and the boundary cases (confidence === 75 kept, missing field defaults to 100) need the agent log. Asserting 'no low-confidence finding appears' is unfalsifiable here. The Suppressed count in the review-details table is the manual read. Labelled `mechanical` (mergewatch.ai#660): any completed review posts the summary comment (postSummaryOnClean defaults to true; `stayingSilent`, review-agent.ts:1051) and renders a score badge (`formatReviewComment`, comment-formatter.ts:760), so a full-range score and a present comment hold for every model output.
